chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Marry blue-eyed women, for indeed there is blessing in them."

key_terms.تَزَوَّجُوا: marry; an instruction to enter marriage
key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about marrying blue-eyed women?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a saying of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم encouraging marriage to blue-eyed women and describing blessing in them. It appears in the context of qualities regarded as favorable in choosing a spouse.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4361 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Marry women with blue eyes, for indeed there is blessing in them."
